svg.title: Job methods are built from a few shared pieces
svg.desc: Matrix computed from src/job_expansion.cpp: which job methods and helpers each Expand<Type>Job calls, which events it creates itself, and which edge helpers it calls itself.
svg.metadata: ["The 14 job methods, one per row. Eleven implement a job type and are dispatched by ExpandJob(); the last 3 are helpers that other methods call.", "Calls: which other job methods and helpers each method calls directly. Composite jobs pass their own job_index down, so the callee's events belong to the caller's job.", "Creates directly: which event types a method constructs itself, with make_shared<...> or the MakeTrayMove / MakeAgvPoseMove builders. Many methods create no TrayMove themselves; they get one from a callee.", "Edge helpers: whether a method calls AddChainedEvent / ChainAfterLastEntityEvent, OrderAfterJobLeafEvents or OrderAfterBayAndChargerEvents itself rather than through a callee.", "ExpandReparkTrayJob is the workhorse: 6 other methods create their TrayMoves through it, so OrderAfterBayAndChargerEvents, the heading policy and the VECS checks live in one place."]
